Usage: zealakit [options] [command]

Recipe-based project scaffolding. Start with `zealakit create` (supports
--discover and --template).

Options:
  -V, --version                    output the version number
  --info                           Print kit metadata (alias of `zealakit info`)
  --json                           With --info: print only machine-readable JSON
  -h, --help                       display help for command

Commands:
  create [options] [project-name]  Create a new project. Modes: interactive
                                   prompts, --discover (recommendations), or
                                   --template <id>.
  info [options]                   Print kit metadata: templates, recipes,
                                   ecosystems, categories, Discovery profiles
  doctor [options]                 Check Zealakit runtime and optional Go
                                   toolchain availability
  discovery                        Local Project Discovery feedback and
                                   stateless JSON queries (offline; no network
                                   uploads)
  preset                           Manage saved create presets (user-level plus
                                   ./zealakit.config.json)
  add [options] <recipes...>       Add recipes to an existing project (reads
                                   zealakit.json; previews a diff first)
  outdated [options]               Compare this project's template/recipe
                                   dependency ranges with the installed kit
                                   (report only)
  recipe                           Author external recipes (data-only folders
                                   with recipe.json)
  mcp [options]                    Run an MCP server on stdio so AI agents can
                                   plan, create, add and check projects
